title: Onboard Meridian-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Mina Rao
release_notes:
- Add Meridian-13B v1.0 to model registry with validated metadata and performance profiles.
- Automated changelog entry generation for model onboarding.
- New presubmit validations for model metadata and perf profiles.
description: Adds Meridian-13B v1.0 to the model registry with complete metadata, machine-validated performance profiles, and an automated changelog/release-notes entry. Context: Meridian is a community 13B model that performs well for instruction-following tasks used by several customers; ENG-4821 tracked onboarding tasks. Motivation: provide accurate perf profiles so routing and cost/latency estimates are correct and reduce manual work when publishing release notes. What this PR does: (1) Adds models/meridian-13b/metadata.yaml with schema-compliant fields (authors, licenses, tokenizer, recommended quantization profiles, reproducible model identifiers). (2) Adds perf/profiles/meridian-13b_v1.json with latency and throughput profiles collected from the perf lab (benchmarked on T4-16 and A10G-8 configs) including sequence length buckets and token-per-second stats. (3) Adds a small validation tool (tools/model-onboard/validate_metadata.py) that runs in presubmit to enforce required fields and simple sanity checks for perf numbers. (4) Extends scripts/changelog/auto_changelog.py to detect new model entries and render a templated release note linkable to Linear/Jira tasks. (5) Adds docs entry docs/models/meridian-13b.md summarizing intended use cases and recommended serving profiles. Backwards compatibility: metadata schema version bumped to 1.2 but includes a compatibility layer in validate_metadata.py to accept 1.0/1.1 payloads and emit warnings rather than hard fails. Testing: added unit tests for metadata validation and a perf test that checks profile JSON parses and all required buckets are present. CI: presubmit runs validation, unit tests, lint, and a lightweight perf sanity check. Rollout: merge will trigger the registry automation to publish the changelog draft and surface the model in the internal model catalog UI. Related: PM-1192 for release coordination, SUP-8721 for customer onboarding request. Checklist: - [x] Metadata YAML authored and validated locally - [x] Perf profiles uploaded and validated - [x] Presubmit validations wired into ci/presubmit.yml - [x] Docs page drafted - [x] Automated changelog tooling updated - [x] Unit/integration tests added Notes: perf numbers represent median across 5 runs and include standard deviation in the profile file. We intentionally left recommended quantization settings as guidance only; teams can pin alternatives per Dedicated/Private deployments.
commit_summary: Generate perf profile meridian-13b_v1.json from perf-lab runs
Add validation script and presubmit integration
Update auto_changelog to include model onboarding entries
Add docs page and unit tests

summary: Onboards Meridian-13B v1.0 with validated metadata, perf profiles, presubmit validations, docs, and automated changelog entry generation.
